record.name: Specialized CPU
str: A specialized CPU unit for Walkers, needed to calculate weight distribution, priority goals, and pathfinding. Worth quite a bit, but you have a feeling you might want to hang on to it.

record.name: Recharging Battery Stack
str: A heavy battery stack designed to oldworld standards, able to recharge itself through long-lost mechanics. Useless in this world, but could help to power up heavy machinery, such as Walkers.

record.name: Ever-Blue Sky AuthCard
str: Authentication card based on RFID technology to allow the user higher access levels for Ever-Blue Sky (TM) integrated Co-Bot scheduling processes. At least that is what it says on the back of the card. Could come in handy, better keep it around.
